faqItems.question: Can I try Eazybe for free?
faqItems.answer: Yes! We offer a 4-day free trial on Starter and Scaler plans. No credit card required. You can explore all features and see how Eazybe integrates with your existing workflow before committing.

faqItems.question: What is Revenue Inbox?
faqItems.answer: Revenue Inbox is our intelligent dashboard that surfaces the most important WhatsApp conversations that need attention. It uses AI to identify hot deals, escalations, and opportunities you might miss in a busy inbox.

faqItems.question: What is RevOps Agent?
faqItems.answer: RevOps Agent is our AI-powered assistant that automates revenue operations tasks. It can analyze conversations, update CRM records, identify deal risks, and provide actionable insights to help you close more deals.

faqItems.question: What is WhatsApp Web Copilot?
faqItems.answer: WhatsApp Web Copilot is our AI assistant that works directly in your WhatsApp Web interface. It helps you draft responses, summarize conversations, and provides real-time suggestions to improve your customer communication.

faqItems.question: How does per-user pricing work?
faqItems.answer: You pay for each team member who actively uses Eazybe. A user is anyone who syncs their WhatsApp conversations to your CRM. Admins who only view data don't count as users.

faqItems.question: Which CRMs do you integrate with?
faqItems.answer: Starter integrates with HubSpot, Zoho CRM, Bitrix24, and Google Sheets. Scaler adds Salesforce and webhook integrations for custom CRMs. Omnis includes dedicated APIs and sync to deals/tickets.

faqItems.question: Can I switch plans later?
faqItems.answer: Absolutely! You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. When upgrading, you get immediate access to new features. When downgrading, the change takes effect at your next billing cycle.

faqItems.question: Is my data secure?
faqItems.answer: Yes. We use bank-grade 256-bit encryption for all data in transit and at rest. We are GDPR compliant, Meta Business Partner verified, and undergo regular security audits.

items.q: What is a WhatsApp AI Agent and how does it work?

It uses large language models to qualify leads, answer support tickets, sync chats to your CRM and trigger workflows in real time. Eazybe installs as a Chrome extension on WhatsApp Web and works in 10 minutes with no code required.

readMore.h0: What Is A WhatsApp AI Agent?
readMore.p0a: A WhatsApp AI Agent is an autonomous AI program that reads and understands and responds to WhatsApp messages on behalf of a business. Unlike a rule based chatbot that follows fixed scripts a WhatsApp AI Agent uses large language models to qualify leads and answer support questions and sync conversations to your CRM and trigger sales workflows in real time.
readMore.p0b: Eazybe builds no-code WhatsApp AI agents trained on your top reps' real conversations. They install in 10 minutes as a Chrome extension run alongside the WhatsApp Web your team already uses and write every interaction back into HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Pipedrive, and 5+ other CRMs.
readMore.h1: Why Do WhatsApp AI Agents Outperform Traditional Chatbots And CRMs?
readMore.p1a: Sales reps want three things from their tooling speed, context and memory of what was already said. Most WhatsApp chatbots miss two of those, and most CRMs miss all three because they aren't in the conversation in the first place. A WhatsApp AI Agent like Eazybe sits between. It reads each chat as it happens, writes back to your CRM, and answers leads at 3am the same way it does at 3pm.
readMore.p1b: That part matters more than it sounds. A lead who messages at 11pm is roughly twice as likely to convert if they get a real reply in a minute versus waiting until the next morning. Your WhatsApp AI Agent handles the night-shift conversation. The rep picks it up the next day with the full thread already logged in HubSpot or Salesforce.
readMore.p1c: Different agents handle different stages. Lead Qualification screens inbound. Revenue Ops watches deals that have gone quiet. Customer Success picks up support and renewals. Agent Builder is the escape hatch for anything custom (renewal nudges, post-demo recaps, NPS pings). They share the same context, so a deal that starts in qualification doesn't lose its history when it moves to closing.
readMore.p1d: Net effect: less manual data entry, fewer threads that die out of nowhere, and pipelines that match what's actually happening in chat.
readMore.h2: Key Features Of The Best WhatsApp AI Agent
readMore.p2a: Most WhatsApp tools fall into two camps. Scripted chatbots break the moment a customer say something the script did not anticipate. CRM plugins mirror messages without understanding them. The best WhatsApp AI Agent platforms sit in a third category: agents that read what's being said and write back to the right record.

readMore.p3a: The usual stack is a WhatsApp Business App and a CRM and a chatbot of some kind and a meeting-notes tool. Each owns a slice of the customer relationship and none of them talk to each other. Eazybe handles the live conversation itself and writes it back to the CRM you already pay for, so the rest of the stack doesn't have to translate.
